A_provenance.task: Algorithm Robustness and Strengthening Research Pass

determinism.note: identical inputs => identical full summary dict

D_parameter_neighbourhood.note: pre-declared grid ('research_window' only); serially evaluated; no parameter was fitted and no protected day was read

G_failure_categories.note: mutually exclusive priority cost_flip > stop_hit > whipsaw > adverse_hold; stop_hit measured against the paper stop-loss band (2%) with a 5% band tolerance; whipsaw uses the opposite crossover within 25 bars (~1 trading day); descriptive only

I_loss_clusters.note: drawdown measured on the closed-trade cumulative net curve (equity proxy); same simplification as the health monitor

K_alternative_strategies.framework: per-day replay, portfolio resets daily (walk-forward challenger semantics)
K_alternative_strategies.note: all candidates are the repo's frozen walk-forward catalog variants; no new strategy was introduced and no parameter was fitted

limitations: Single market (NIFTY 50) and single instrument deck; no multi-instrument generalisation.
Single historical sample; regime and failure labels are descriptive associations, not causal claims.
Fresh/OOS validation is out of scope and blocked by the gate (pool NOT_READY).

safeguard_snapshot.note: snapshot only; this pass performs no execution, no order placement and no network activity

operator_consent.purpose: WS 7.24B controlled live BUY-SELL round-trip execution test

strengthening_hypotheses.hypothesis: Friction is the dominant drag, not the signal: zero-cost runs roughly cost-neutral (net 684.55) while base friction loses -112692.554219635 and pays 113377.104219635 in costs; the gap between net health-bucket expectancy (C) and gross research expectancy (D) is exactly this friction.
strengthening_hypotheses.validate_by: dedicated single-hypothesis research passes; OOS gate remains CLOSED

strengthening_hypotheses.hypothesis: The dominant failure mode is fast whipsaw reversion: 1648 trades (of 2091) exit on the opposite crossover within ~1 trading day and account for -131313.089053705 net PnL; hard stops fire rarely (stop_hit=3). Reducing whipsaw turnover (stay out of the crossover-echo zone, or confirm) is the highest-leverage lever before cost redesign.
strengthening_hypotheses.validate_by: dedicated single-hypothesis research passes; OOS gate remains CLOSED

strengthening_hypotheses.hypothesis: Losses concentrate in sideways regimes (1959 of 2091 trades / -104744.796013130 net PnL); regime-gating (already present in the challenger family) must trade win-rate lift against the near-total absence of opportune trades it produces in this sample.
strengthening_hypotheses.validate_by: dedicated single-hypothesis research passes; OOS gate remains CLOSED

strengthening_hypotheses.hypothesis: The long-hold bucket is the only positive sub-population but is tiny and fragile (n=13); nothing in the evidence supports lengthening holds as a robust repair.
strengthening_hypotheses.validate_by: dedicated single-hypothesis research passes; OOS gate remains CLOSED

strengthening_hypotheses.hypothesis: The frozen regime-filtered challenger family does not outrank the champion at base friction in the dev window — the bottleneck is structural (cost vs win rate), not the trend gate. No challenger is promoted.
strengthening_hypotheses.validate_by: dedicated single-hypothesis research passes; OOS gate remains CLOSED
